pages.title: Meet the Cats
pages.content:
# Welcome to The Clowder

Somewhere between myth and mischief, thirteen cats live rent-free in our hearts (and on this website). They don't pay taxes. They don't apologize. They simply *are*.

Scroll down. Meet them. Try not to pick a favorite — you will fail.

---

## 🐱 Biscuit Flompton
**Personality:** Aggressively wholesome. Makes biscuits on everything — laptops, faces, sourdough starters. Has never had a bad day and refuses to acknowledge that bad days exist.

---

## 🐱 Lord Vincenzo
**Personality:** Convinced he is nobility. Wears a ruff (a small paper one taped to his collar). Accepts tribute in the form of shrimp. Will not make eye contact with commoners.

---

## 🐱 Noodle
**Personality:** Completely boneless, apparently. Found in a new impossible position every morning. Deeply unbothered. Spiritually a puddle.

---

## 🐱 Detective Marmalade
**Personality:** Investigates everything. The laundry. The wall. The sound from three Tuesdays ago. Has solved zero cases but remains confident. Takes notes (scratches furniture).

---

## 🐱 Grievances
**Personality:** Named for her primary hobby. Sits at the top of the stairs and stares down at you until you apologize. You don't know what for. She does.

---

## 🐱 Professor Tubbs
**Personality:** Round. Scholarly. Has sat on every book in the house and absorbed their knowledge. Gives lectures (yowls) at 3 a.m. Tenure is implied.

---

## 🐱 Slim Pickens
**Personality:** A consummate drama queen despite weighing 14 pounds. Faints theatrically when dinner is two minutes late. Has a go-bag. Has never needed it.

---

## 🐱 Waffles the Unbroken
**Personality:** Has survived seventeen attempts to put her in a cat carrier. Strategist. War veteran. Currently napping in the carrier voluntarily, just to flex.

---

## 🐱 Horatio Plunk
**Personality:** Scared of everything — but only *new* everything. Old frightening things are fine. New frightening things (a bag, a breeze, the concept of Thursday) require immediate hiding.

---

## 🐱 Duchess Cremepuff
**Personality:** Glamorous. Has standards. Will only drink water that is running, slightly cold, and poured with acknowledgment of her greatness. Judges your interior design.

---

## 🐱 Socks Malone
**Personality:** Four white paws. Criminal record (alleged). Knocks things off shelves with the energy of someone who has already spoken to a lawyer. Remorseless.

---

## 🐱 Tangerine Dream
**Personality:** Orange and therefore chaotic. Runs at full speed toward walls and pivots at the last possible second. It's a lifestyle. It's a philosophy. It's a cry for help.

---

## 🐱 Meredith the Ancient
**Personality:** Old beyond reckoning. Has seen empires rise and fall. Knows things. Naps through everything. Occasionally opens one eye and you feel, briefly, that you have been judged across millennia.

---

*The Clowder thanks you for your visit. The cats do not — but they were not asked.*

pages.title: About The Clowder
pages.content:
# About This Place

## What is The Clowder?

A clowder is the official collective noun for a group of cats. We chose it because it sounds vaguely ominous and also because *thirteen cats* deserved something grander than just 'a bunch.'

This site exists to celebrate thirteen fictional felines — each one a distinct, fully-realized personality carved from equal parts affection, absurdist humor, and too many hours spent watching cat videos at 2 a.m.

## Why 13?

Thirteen is considered unlucky by some. Cats are considered suspicious by others. Combining the two felt correct. Also we just really like cats and couldn't stop at twelve.

## Are these real cats?

No. They are imaginary. But if you have looked at this site and thought *that is my cat, you have described my cat exactly* — then in some sense, perhaps, they are all real.

## Can I submit my cat?

The Clowder is closed. Thirteen is the perfect number. It was always thirteen.

---

*Made with love, dark mode, and a concerning amount of cat knowledge.*
